meaning: Evidence sidecar for the main-side Lean package, following the Math- formal lane contract (docs/FORMAL_VERIFICATION.md, work item #95). `proved` here means proof text supplied and bound by hash; `kernel-checked` is reported only by the receipt of a trusted --run-lean execution at an exact commit. Alignment is a separate pending/accepted/stale dimension. Nothing in this file is a scientific register entry or changes any ACCEPT/AMEND disposition.
